title: Cologne Cathedral

buildingCutout.basis: Replace the main cathedral and the constituent PMTiles building parts. Separate narrow portal and tower pinnacles follow their own mapped outlines.

groundCutout.basis: Open source terrain below the native cathedral walls and footings while preserving the plaza paving.

note: The nave, twin towers and transepts follow the surveyed exterior plan. The west entrance sets the vertical datum from local terrain. The plaza, station and adjacent buildings remain host features.
